# 2. Sequence Diagrams

## 2.1 Normal authorization check with L1 hit

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor User
    participant Gateway as Gateway PEP
    participant L1 as Local L1 Cache
    participant Service as Order Service

    User->>Gateway: GET /order-sagas/by-order/{id} + JWT
    Gateway->>Gateway: Verify JWT and resolve tenant/subject
    Gateway->>L1: get(decision key with versions)
    L1-->>Gateway: ALLOW
    Gateway->>Service: gRPC + service token + delegated actor
    Service-->>Gateway: Order Saga
    Gateway-->>User: HTTP 200
```

## 2.2 Authorization check with Redis and PDP fallback

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor User
    participant PEP as Gateway or Service PEP
    participant L1 as L1 Cache
    participant Redis as Redis L2
    participant PDP as Identity Authorization gRPC
    participant DB as Identity PostgreSQL

    User->>PEP: Request
    PEP->>PEP: Verify token and build authorization request
    PEP->>L1: Lookup decision
    L1-->>PEP: Miss
    PEP->>Redis: GET versioned decision key
    Redis-->>PEP: Miss
    PEP->>PDP: CheckPermission
    PDP->>DB: Load account, tenant, membership, roles, permissions, resource scopes, versions
    DB-->>PDP: Authorization context
    PDP->>PDP: Evaluate wildcard, permission and resource policy
    PDP-->>PEP: ALLOW or DENY + versions + TTL
    PEP->>Redis: SET decision with TTL and jitter
    PEP->>L1: PUT decision with short TTL
    PEP-->>User: Continue or deny
```

## 2.3 Grant permission to role

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor Admin
    participant Gateway
    participant IdentityAPI as Identity Administration
    participant DB as PostgreSQL
    participant Outbox as Identity Outbox
    participant Relay as Outbox Relay
    participant MQTT as MQTT Broker
    participant Redis
    participant Services as Gateway and Service Subscribers

    Admin->>Gateway: Grant permission P to role R
    Gateway->>IdentityAPI: gRPC GrantPermissionToRole
    IdentityAPI->>DB: BEGIN
    IdentityAPI->>DB: Validate admin, role, permission
    IdentityAPI->>DB: INSERT sf_role_permission
    IdentityAPI->>DB: Increment tenant authorization version
    IdentityAPI->>Outbox: INSERT ROLE_PERMISSION_CHANGED event
    IdentityAPI->>DB: COMMIT
    IdentityAPI-->>Gateway: Updated role + tenant version
    Gateway-->>Admin: Success

    par Redis generation update
        IdentityAPI->>Redis: SET tenant version
    and Event publication
        Relay->>Outbox: Claim unpublished event
        Relay->>MQTT: Publish QoS 1 invalidation
        MQTT-->>Relay: PUBACK
        Relay->>Outbox: Mark published
    end

    MQTT-->>Services: ROLE_PERMISSION_CHANGED
    Services->>Services: Deduplicate eventId
    Services->>Services: Update local tenant version
    Services->>Services: Evict tenant L1 entries

    Note over Services,Redis: Old Redis decision keys remain physically but cannot match the new version.
```

## 2.4 Revoke permission from role

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor Admin
    participant Gateway
    participant IdentityAPI as Identity Administration
    participant DB as PostgreSQL
    participant Outbox
    participant Redis
    participant MQTT
    participant PEP as All PEP Nodes

    Admin->>Gateway: Revoke permission P from role R
    Gateway->>IdentityAPI: gRPC RevokePermissionFromRole
    IdentityAPI->>DB: BEGIN
    IdentityAPI->>DB: Lock role/version rows
    IdentityAPI->>DB: DELETE sf_role_permission
    IdentityAPI->>DB: Increment tenant authorization version
    IdentityAPI->>Outbox: Insert invalidation event in same transaction
    IdentityAPI->>DB: COMMIT
    IdentityAPI->>Redis: Publish new tenant version
    IdentityAPI-->>Gateway: Success

    Outbox->>MQTT: Publish ROLE_PERMISSION_CHANGED, QoS 1
    MQTT-->>PEP: Invalidation event
    PEP->>PEP: Evict tenant L1 and update version marker

    Note over PEP: A request missing the MQTT event still reads the new version from Redis or PDP.
    PEP->>Redis: Read current version before reusing a stale decision
    Redis-->>PEP: New tenant version
    PEP->>PEP: Reject old cache key and re-evaluate
```

## 2.5 Assign or revoke a role for one subject

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant Admin
    participant Identity
    participant DB
    participant Outbox
    participant MQTT
    participant PEP

    Admin->>Identity: AssignRole or RevokeRole
    Identity->>DB: Update sf_membership_role
    Identity->>DB: Increment subject authorization version
    Identity->>Outbox: Insert MEMBERSHIP_ROLE_CHANGED
    Identity->>DB: Commit
    Outbox->>MQTT: Publish subject invalidation
    MQTT-->>PEP: tenantId + subjectId + subjectVersion
    PEP->>PEP: Evict only subject L1 entries
```

## 2.6 Create or update permission definition

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant Service as Owning Service
    participant Registry as Identity Permission Registry
    participant DB
    participant Outbox
    participant MQTT
    participant PEP

    Service->>Registry: RegisterPermissionDefinitions(service, namespace, checksum, definitions)
    Registry->>Registry: Authenticate service and validate namespace ownership
    Registry->>DB: Upsert permission metadata
    alt Catalog changed
        Registry->>DB: Increment catalog version
        Registry->>Outbox: Insert CATALOG_CHANGED event
    else No change
        Registry->>Registry: Return unchanged
    end
    Registry-->>Service: Registration result + catalog version
    Outbox->>MQTT: Publish catalog invalidation
    MQTT-->>PEP: New catalog version
    PEP->>PEP: Clear local catalog/decision caches
```

## 2.7 Missed MQTT event recovery

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant PEP
    participant L1
    participant Redis
    participant PDP as Identity PDP

    PEP->>L1: Read cached decision with version 41
    PEP->>Redis: Read subject/tenant/catalog versions
    Redis-->>PEP: Effective version 42
    PEP->>L1: Evict stale version 41
    PEP->>PDP: CheckPermission with known version 41
    PDP-->>PEP: Decision at version 42
    PEP->>L1: Cache version 42
```

## 2.8 Redis unavailable

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant PEP
    participant L1
    participant Redis
    participant PDP as Identity PDP

    PEP->>L1: Miss
    PEP->>Redis: GET
    Redis--xPEP: Connection failure
    PEP->>PDP: Direct CheckPermission
    PDP-->>PEP: Decision
    PEP->>L1: Cache short-lived decision
```

## 2.9 Identity unavailable, fail closed

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant Caller
    participant PEP
    participant Redis
    participant PDP as Identity PDP

    Caller->>PEP: Privileged request
    PEP->>Redis: Cache miss
    PEP->>PDP: CheckPermission
    PDP--xPEP: Unavailable or deadline exceeded
    PEP-->>Caller: Deny AUTHORIZATION_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE
```
